import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
namespace MvPolynomial.EvalTaylorExtra
#check @MvPolynomial.comp_aeval
universe u v w
#check_failure MvPolynomial.eval_taylor
section Weakening
variable (σ R : Type*) [Semiring R]
#check_failure (MvPolynomial.eval : (σ → R) → MvPolynomial σ R →+* R)
end Weakening
section General
variable {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} {A : Type w} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring A]
  [Algebra R A]
theorem baseChange (α : σ → R) (x : σ → A) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval x (MvPolynomial.aeval
      (fun j ↦ MvPolynomial.X j + MvPolynomial.C (α j)) P) =
      MvPolynomial.aeval (fun j ↦ x j + algebraMap R A (α j)) P := by
  have h := MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply (R := R)
    (f := fun j ↦ MvPolynomial.X j + MvPolynomial.C (α j))
    (MvPolynomial.aeval x : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] A) P
  simpa only [map_add, aeval_X, aeval_C] using h
theorem homForm (f : σ → MvPolynomial σ R) (x : σ → R) :
    (MvPolynomial.aeval x).comp (MvPolynomial.aeval f) =
      MvPolynomial.aeval (fun j ↦ MvPolynomial.aeval x (f j)) :=
  MvPolynomial.comp_aeval (f := f) (MvPolynomial.aeval x : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] R)
#print axioms baseChange
#print axioms homForm
end General
end MvPolynomial.EvalTaylorExtra
